stock.description: Stream Ideas Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides online advertising services to brand owners and advertising agencies. The company’s online advertising services include social viral, engager, and mass blogging services. It operates in Hong Kong, Taiwan, Malaysia, and the Philippines. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.
